purpose: FLSA regular rate of pay and overtime premium per 29 CFR 778, Subpart C, including nondiscretionary-bonus reallocation into the regular rate (778.110, 778.208-778.209) and the 0.5x overtime premium for hours over 40 in the workweek (778.107). Federal only, not legal advice; state daily/weekly overtime rules out of scope. Multi-workweek bonus proration is the caller's responsibility: nondiscretionary_bonus_amount is the portion already allocated to the single workweek being computed. Not compute_gross_to_net or compute_federal_withholding, which handle payroll tax withholding rather than wage-hour overtime obligations.
